caption: The drawing depicts a semicircular wooden plaque featuring a central bust of a man shown in profile, facing towards the right. The man has dark, curly hair and a dark mustache, and is dressed in a brown jacket, a white shirt, and a red cravat or scarf. The bust is draped with a red fabric over the left shoulder. Ornate yellow and gold scrollwork surrounds the bust on both sides, forming a symmetrical design. The background behind the man and scrollwork is painted to represent textured blue-gray wooden planks. Encircling the upper perimeter of the plaque is a border of interlocking gold-colored leaves, resembling a laurel wreath. The composition is set against a plain off-white background, with no additional objects present. Small handwriting is located in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Stern Board from Ship "John Penrose"
